name: Valentina Hidalgo
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After earning a degree in engineering, she initially worked in the mining industry, but a chance encounter with a local rally team ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. She quickly transitioned, applying her analytical skills to race strategy, and her knack for predicting track conditions and competitor tactics became invaluable.

Throughout her career, Valentina has been known for her meticulous preparation and ability to remain calm under pressure. She favors a data-driven approach, combining sophisticated simulations with a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. What truly sets her apart is her unwavering loyalty and dedication to her team, fostering a collaborative environment where every voice is heard and valued. Her teams have consistently punched above their weight, thanks to her insightful strategies and motivational leadership.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle auburn highlights.
physical.description: Valentina has a warm, engaging presence, with a focused gaze that reflects her sharp intellect.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on a pre-race ritual of drinking mate with the team.
Has an uncanny ability to predict weather changes based on barometric pressure readings.
